jobs.title: Software Engineer, Fraud System Interventions
jobs.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe, LLC. is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. What you’ll do Responsibilities Develop and manage platforms and solutions to minimize financial and regulatory risk while maintaining excellent user experience. Diagnose and resolve production issues across various services and throughout the tech stack. Proactively identify, analyze, and swiftly mitigate emerging risk patterns. Partner with diverse stakeholders, which include: engineering, product, policy, legal, operations, and data science teams. Collaborate with other engineers to build modular, composable Fraud control systems. jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. Your role Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us. To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career. Who you are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum requirements A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience). Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present. Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting). Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes. Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs. Preferred qualifications One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems. Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases. Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers. Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, UI Platform
jobs.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The UI Platform team, known as Sail, builds the foundations behind Stripe’s Dashboard and many other user interfaces. Sail Services owns the systems that evaluate feature flags and experiments, ingest frontend analytics, and improve Dashboard load times for Stripe’s largest merchants. We build backend-for-frontend capabilities that connect Stripe’s backend systems to its UI platform. This gives product teams a consistent way to build and operate user experiences without recreating the same infrastructure. What you’ll do As a Backend Engineer on the Sail Services team, you’ll help build and evolve the systems that power Stripe’s user interfaces. You’ll independently drive software projects from problem definition through production, working closely with other UI Platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure partners. Your work will range from APIs and GraphQL integrations to edge systems, architectural migrations, and the tooling needed to operate them safely at scale. Responsibilities Take end-to-end ownership of software projects, aligning on priorities and then independently scoping problems and carrying solutions through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operation Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable APIs and backend systems that support Stripe’s Dashboard, mobile applications, and other user interfaces Help modernize Stripe’s UI architecture through incremental migrations, automated validation, shadow traffic, and carefully controlled production rollouts Improve the reliability, observability, performance, and operability of services on critical user paths Partner with frontend, backend, and infrastructure engineers to understand their needs and turn recurring problems into reusable platform capabilities Use AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to improve implementation, testing, validation, and delivery Contribute thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, and runbooks that improve the quality of the team’s work Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Fluency in using AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of day-to-day software engineering, including critically reviewing, validating, and improving generated code 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience, building, shipping, and operating production systems Strong knowledge of backend technologies and infrastructure, including the fundamentals of APIs, data storage, distributed systems, and production operations Ability to independently scope and deliver open-ended software projects, making practical technical and product tradeoffs with limited oversight Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to testing, maintainability, reliability, and user impact Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers, product engineers, and infrastructure partners Preferred qualifications Experience building backend-for-frontend systems, UI platform services, developer platforms, or shared infrastructure Experience designing or integrating APIs, including GraphQL APIs Experience with high-throughput event ingestion, feature flag or experimentation systems, or other latency-sensitive platform services Familiarity with caching, asynchronous systems, configuration systems, or data-consistency tradeoffs Experience executing large migrations using automated validation, shadow traffic, feature flags, or staged rollouts Experience using data, developer feedback, or operational signals to improve a platform or developer-facing product

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Payments
jobs.description: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. Airbnb Payments team supports this mission by economically empowering Airbnb businesses and our global community of guests and hosts. The Payments Growth team builds the payments features that drive Airbnb's revenue growth. We are a product-focused team that works with Product, Design, Data Science and Finance to deliver projects that grow the business. Our flagship product is the Earnings Dashboard, the one-stop place where Hosts track their earnings and performance, get recommendations on how to improve, and download reports. It is one of the most visited pages for our community of over 5 million Hosts worldwide, and when Hosts earn more, Airbnb grows too The Difference You Will Make: Build backend services and APIs for the Earnings Dashboard and other payments features that help Hosts grow their income and drive Airbnb revenue. Translate product, compliance and regulatory requirements into clean, well-tested code. Build the data and services behind Host performance metrics, recommendations and reports, and keep them accurate and fast for Hosts of every size. Implement experimentation, logging and metrics so Product and Data Science can test changes and measure their impact on Hosts and the business. Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Finance, Legal and other engineering teams to deliver projects that grow the business. Use data to find gaps in conversion, Host engagement and reliability, and drive fixes and improvements. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions and operational improvements across the team. A Typical Day: Architect and implement complex features, focusing on data-driven decision making and performance optimizations. Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional partners across the organization to understand and prioritize technical requirements. Proactively grow knowledge of leading edge practices and trends. Help define and improve coding standards, development processes and best practices. Your Expertise: 2+ years of experience in a hands-on software engineering role in backend/full-stack development. Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience. Exposure to Java, and experience building services in a distributed microservice environment Fluency in frontend web technologies (e.g. HTML, CSS, React and Graphql etc) Demonstrated expertise in backend systems within large-scale service-oriented architectures. Passionate about efficiency, availability, technical quality and system quality. Excellent communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work well within engineering organization and cross functions. Your Location: This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. Equal Employment Opportunity : Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $160,000 — $180,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: SDE II - Data Engineer
jobs.description: InMobi (Corporate) InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. InMobi Advertising InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com. Glance Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com. Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on SDE-II – Data Engineer to join InMobi’s Demand-Side Platform (DSP) team. In this role, you will build, maintain, and optimise scalable data pipelines that support programmatic advertising, campaign analytics, audience targeting, and attribution. You will work with batch and streaming data, distributed processing frameworks, cloud data platforms, and analytical storage systems to transform large volumes of data into reliable and actionable insights. You will collaborate with backend, product, and ML engineering teams to develop efficient data solutions that support DSP operations. This role is ideal for an engineer with strong fundamentals in Python, SQL, and distributed data processing who is keen to solve data engineering challenges involving high-volume event streams, performance optimisation, and data reliability. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Engineering and Pipeline Development Develop, maintain, and optimise end-to-end batch and streaming data pipelines for processing events such as bid requests, impressions, clicks, and conversion signals. Build data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python, SQL, Apache Spark/PySpark, and relevant data engineering frameworks. Work with data lakehouse architectures and contribute to ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving layers. Implement data quality checks, schema validation, error handling, and monitoring to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Support data modelling and query optimisation for analytical and reporting workloads. Contribute to pipeline performance improvements, resource utilisation, and efficient compute and storage usage. 2. Distributed Processing and Streaming Work with distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, PySpark, and Apache Kafka . Develop and support streaming workflows for processing event-driven data, with attention to data freshness, reliability, and processing efficiency. Implement mechanisms for handling duplicate, delayed, or failed events, including retries, checkpointing, and recovery where applicable. Investigate production issues and troubleshoot data pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data quality discrepancies. Contribute to the adoption and effective use of technologies such as Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, and open table formats where relevant to the platform. 3. Data Storage and Analytics Work with cloud-based data platforms and storage services to support scalable data processing and analytics. Develop and optimise SQL queries, data transformations, partitioning strategies, and table structures. Contribute to analytical data stores such as StarRocks, ClickHouse, or similar technologies, based on project requirements. Work with data lake table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi, where applicable. Support data modelling, metadata management, access controls, and data retention practices in line with established engineering standards. 4. Collaboration and Engineering Practices Collaborate with backend engineers, ML engineers, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable data solutions. Work with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and deployment activities. Follow engineering best practices for version control, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and production readiness. Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance pipeline reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency. Required Skills and Qualifications Experience and Education 2–5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or big data development. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in a production environment. Experience handling large datasets or distributed data processing workloads is preferred. Exposure to ad-tech, programmatic advertising, real-time bidding (RTB), or event-driven systems is an added advantage. Core Data Engineering Skills Strong programming skills in Python . Good command of SQL , including joins, aggregations, data transformations, and query optimisation. Hands-on experience with Apache Spark/PySpark or a comparable distributed data processing framework. Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines. Understanding of batch processing and streaming data concepts. Exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster. Understanding of data modelling, partitioning, schema evolution, and data quality practices. Streaming, Cloud, and Data Platform Skills Familiarity with Apache Kafka or similar messaging and streaming technologies. Exposure to AWS, GCP, or Azure data services. Familiarity with data lakes, lakehouse architectures, or analytical databases. Exposure to Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, StarRocks, or ClickHouse is an advantage. Understanding of monitoring, logging, error handling, and production troubleshooting. Preferred Skills Experience processing high-volume event data or building near-real-time data pipelines. Exposure to ad-tech datasets such as bid requests, impressions, clicks, conversions, campaign performance, or attribution data. Familiarity with Java or Scala in addition to Python. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Germany Forward Deployed
jobs.description:
NOTE: Although this position is in support of our US Government work, this role is located in Wiesbaden, Germany.
 
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
As an FDSE your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. 
 
Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - CIAM
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Affirm is building the next generation of customer identity and authentication. This role is a hands-on, mid-engineering position inside Information Security, contributing to core CIAM capabilities that protect customers and support growth. You will help build and maintain backend services that power registration, login, authorization, and account lifecycle flows across B2C and B2B experiences. You will work with experienced engineers and partner teams to deliver scoped identity features with strong security fundamentals, reliability, and operational rigor. What you’ll do Build and ship customer-facing authentication features—from smoother login experiences to MFA, step-up authentication, and device binding—with mentorship from experienced engineers. Develop backend services and APIs in Python or Kotlin, turning product requirements into working software that helps customers access their accounts securely. Work with modern identity technologies such as Okta, Auth0, and ForgeRock, writing custom code and integrations that connect identity capabilities to web, mobile, and partner applications. Take scoped features through the software development lifecycle: contribute to design, write readable code and automated tests, participate in code reviews, and deploy to production with support from the team. Solve real engineering problems by debugging services, improving reliability, and using logs and metrics to understand how your code behaves in production. Collaborate with engineering and product partners, learn secure development practices, and grow your software engineering skills while building expertise in authentication. What we look for We’re looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer with solid engineering fundamentals, a passion for authentication, and an eagerness to learn customer identity and access management. You do not need extensive authentication or CIAM experience—we value your ability to build software, solve problems, and grow in the space. Demonstrated ability to write, test, and debug software in Python, Kotlin, or a similar language through coursework, internships, personal projects, open source, or professional work. No fixed minimum years of experience required. Foundational understanding of backend development, including APIs, data structures, databases, and version control. Genuine curiosity about how authentication works and motivation to build secure, reliable customer experiences. Prior experience with identity protocols or CIAM platforms is a plus, not a requirement. A practical problem-solving approach, willingness to ask questions, and openness to learning through mentorship and code review. Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with engineering, product, and security teammates. This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Base Pay Grade - L Equity Grade - 6 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000 #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer for Flight Physics Capabilities / Loads & Aeroelastics   (d/f/m)
jobs.description: Job Description: Are you eager to pioneer cutting-edge simulation technologies for the future of sustainable aviation? In order to support the intersection of Aerospace Engineering and Software Development , Airbus is looking for a Software Development Engineer for Flight Physics Capabilities / Loads & Aeroelastics (d/f/m) About Us & Locations The Flight Physics domain is at the core of aircraft architecture and system integration. Within our team, we develop, maintain, and advance our internal in-house simulation software for aircraft loads & aeroelastics . You will ideally be working in Hamburg , the largest production site for civil aircraft. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe offers unique perks, such as the option to commute by ferry, allowing you to experience the special flair of Hamburg where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets maritime legacy. As our team operates across international engineering hubs, Bremen (Germany) and Filton (UK) are also possible locations for this role. Across all sites, close collaboration and team spirit are central to how we work, which is why regular on-site presence at your chosen location is required. Your Mission You will be a key developer for our internal loads simulation software. In this role, you will bridge the gap between flight physics domain knowledge and software engineering. You will participate in all phases of the software lifecycle—from defining simulation requirements and architectural design to implementation, automated testing, and deployment. Your code will directly enable engineering teams across Airbus to calculate and evaluate aircraft loads accurately and efficiently. Our Benefits for You Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. Your tasks and responsibilities In-House Simulation Tool Development: Design, code, test, deploy, and continuously enhance our internal simulation software dedicated to aircraft loads and aeroelastics. Algorithm & Architecture Design: Implement advanced numerical methods and physical models into clean, high-performance, and modular code. Requirements Translation: Collaborate closely with Flight Physics loads engineers to translate complex aerodynamic and structural load requirements into efficient software algorithms. User Support & Tool Maintenance: Provide technical support to internal engineering users, troubleshoot simulation issues, and optimize software performance and usability based on user feedback. Engineering Best Practices: Apply modern software engineering standards, including peer code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and comprehensive testing to ensure simulation accuracy and code reliability. Desired skills and qualifications Domain Background: Degree in Aerospace Engineering , Aeronautics , Computational Engineering , Physics , or a related field with a solid understanding of flight physics, aircraft loads, or structural mechanics. Hands-on Programming Skills: Strong coding abilities and solid experience in object-oriented programming (OOP) using Python , C++ , or C# . Systems & Infrastructure: Experience working in Linux environments . Practical knowledge of High-Performance Computing (HPC) , parallel computing, or aeroelastic simulation workflows is a major advantage. Software Engineering Practice: Solid foundation in modern development workflows, including Git/version control , unit testing , and CI/CD practices . Problem-Solving & Mindset: A passion for translating physical engineering problems into robust, automated software tools. Communication & Team Spirit: Excellent communication skills in English, good Level of German speaking with an open, collaborative approach to working in an international engineering team. Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. jobs.description: Job Description: Airbus Defence & Space , recherche Développeur Logiciel Full Stack (Java/Angular) pour son site de Toulouse (France) ou de Friedrichshafen (Allemagne) . Nos solutions et services sont au cœur de nombreux processus métier tout au long du cycle de vie des systèmes spatiaux (appels d'offres, conception, vérification et validation). Frontend Angular : Développer des composants d'interface utilisateur responsives, modulaires et réutilisables avec Angular (TypeScript, HTML5, SCSS/CSS). Langues : Niveau d'anglais avancé requis (à l'écrit comme à l'oral). jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Why this role?

The Web team builds cohere.com http://cohere.com, the public face of Cohere. We work with marketing, design, and leadership to ship polished pages quickly: landing experiences, content-driven UI, and the CMS systems behind them.



As a Web Developer, you will:

 - Work closely with a small team of engineers, designers, and marketing partners

 - Build and iterate on growth-focused UI: styling, layout, and content-driven pages

 - Work with content editors so publishing is faster and less painful. Better workflows, clearer schemas, fewer gotchas

 - Ship experiments and marketing features that help people discover and try Cohere

 - Build in Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind, including the Sanity schemas that power the site

 - Improve performance and reliability where it actually moves the needle, not chase tech for its own sake

 - Use AI coding tools every day, while owning what you merge: you should be able to debug, explain, and stand behind the code
   
   

You may be a good fit if:

 - You’ve spent 2+ years shipping production React/TypeScript apps and care about polish and performance

 - You’re comfortable with Next.js and a headless CMS like Sanity or ready to ramp up quickly

 - You like partnering with design and marketing, and you leave code a bit clearer than you found it

 - You’re excited to try new tools when they help, and skip them when they don’t

 - You care about the end result for users, not just the framework of the week
   
   

Bonus: Eye for design or motion; a portfolio, GitHub, or shipped marketing work. Familiarity with monorepos (pnpm/Turborepo) or Vercel is a plus.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

 - Proficient in TypeScript and NodeJS with a preference for experience in B2C contexts.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, ITC
jobs.description: WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH We are looking for a Software Engineer II specializing in iOS mobile engineering to help design, build and deliver reliable point-of-sale experiences for Nike Stores. You will join the Store Experience organization, which develops front-of-house point-of-sale capabilities and back-of-house reporting and store-management solutions for a global retail environment. The role combines hands-on application development, quality engineering, automation, integration testing, and technical debugging. You will own capabilities from requirements through production, working with product, architecture, infrastructure, security and geographically distributed engineering teams to identify risks early and deliver scalable, secure and supportable solutions. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Design, develop, test and deliver iOS point-of-sale capabilities across cart, checkout, payments, receipts and store integrations. • Build maintainable Swift and Swift UI solutions using modern mobile architecture and Apple Human Interface Guidelines. • Integrate and validate payment solutions, printers, scanners, cash drawers and other store technologies, including market-specific payment and fiscal requirements. • Develop unit, UI, integration and regression tests; automate appropriate scenarios while ensuring hardware- dependent journeys receive hands-on validation. • Use Xcode, application logs, and code-level investigation to troubleshoot complex failures across software, payments, hardware, and dependent services. • Partner with product owners to clarify requirements, define MVP scope, identify technical and quality risks, and support realistic delivery plans. • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, infrastructure, privacy and security teams to ensure applications are properly designed, operated and maintained. • Improve performance, scalability, extensibility, reliability, usability, availability and testability throughout the development of lifecycle. • Participate in sprint planning and Scrum ceremonies, contribute to estimation and execution, and drive defects through root-cause analysis and resolution. • Monitor and support production health using engineering observability and analytics tools and contribute to continuous improvement through DevOps and Agile practices. • Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and code quality, applying appropriate review, privacy and security practices. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON Deliver reliable, maintainable iOS capabilities that meet functionality, quality, security and operational expectations. • Ensure critical checkout and store-integration journeys are comprehensively validated before release. • Prevent critical production issues through early risk identification, robust engineering practices, and meaningful automated coverage. • Independently investigate and resolve complex failures across application code, payments, hardware and dependent services. • Improve application performance, stability, observability, testability, and release readiness over time. • Communicate engineering status, quality risks and release readiness clearly to technical and business partners.

jobs.description: SOFTWARE ENGINEER I Dong Nai, Vietnam WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH This role is part of the Air Manufacturing Innovation Technology team and partners with architects, business stakeholders, customers, product owners, technical and functional teams, vendors, other Nike facilities, and departments to deliver and support SAP solutions for the VaporMax facility in Dong Nai, Vietnam. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Air Manufacturing Innovation (AirMI) is looking for a strong Software Engineer I with SAP ECC implementation experience and deep Materials Management expertise. The candidate understands Production Planning and Sales and Distribution modules, works effectively in an Agile product environment, and translates complex system functionality into clear business language. They are a self-directed, results-oriented problem solver who can navigate ambiguity, changing priorities, and cross-team dependencies while keeping business value and return on investment in focus. Success requires effective collaboration, relationship management, and strong written, verbal, and presentation skills. The candidate can lead global cross-functional efforts, influence internal and external partners, anticipate customer needs, resolve complex issues, and communicate risks, decisions, status, and escalations clearly to technical, business, and leadership audiences. Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of directly relevant work experience. Demonstrated SAP ECC functional knowledge and implementation experience, with strong expertise in Materials Management and related Supply Chain Management processes. Working knowledge of Production Planning and Sales and Distribution, including cross-module integration with Materials Management; ALE/IDoc and API experience is preferred. Direct experience in a multi-site manufacturing environment; apparel or footwear end-to-end product value chain and direct manufacturing experience is preferred. Occasional travel to the United States is required. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON You will analyze business needs, design and configure SAP solutions, and coordinate delivery across technical and functional teams. You will support the VaporMax facility by translating requirements, managing dependencies and risks, testing changes, and keeping stakeholders informed from solution design through implementation. Perform technical analysis involving advanced data analytics, data mining, source-to-target mapping, and complex process and system diagrams. Gather and document tactical business requirements with remote groups, vendors, other Nike facilities, and departments. Translate business needs into advanced functional specifications and coordinate technical solutions with technology capability resources. Configure Air MI’s SAP instance, apply global process standards, and create reports or package-solution configurations for unique business requirements. Develop test plans and scripts, define expected results, validate outcomes, and communicate system changes in business-relevant language. Coordinate project plans, milestones, cross-team dependencies, risks, blockers, and action items, driving issues through resolution and escalating when needed. Lead and participate in subject-matter-expert discussions, support department and end-user change management, and provide clear status to stakeholders and leadership.

Mastery of assembly (RISC-V, x86, or ARM) and the ability to analyze JIT-generated machine code to identify sub-optimal execution patterns. jobs.description: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. JOB DESCRIPTION: Working at Abbott At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to: · Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. · Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year. · An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution. · Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. · A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. · A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists. The Opportunity Our location in Irving, TX has an open opportunity for a Software Test Engineer on site daily. This role is in Core Labs Division. Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments, and informatics systems is often the first step in patient care decision-making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers. This Position represents test engineering throughout the Software Development Lifecycle. Position performs all the verification and validation SQA functions (test case creation and execution, exploratory testing, test plan and test report creation). Position heavily interacts with the development and quality teams to ensure the right tests are being written and executed. Position includes internal technical leadership tasks. What You’ll Work On Investigate unexpected events, issues, or software bugs. Collaborate in cross-functional teams to trouble-shoot complex system-level field complaints. Report to team leadership on investigation outcome and recommend test plan. Verify fixes. Complete software testing and activities for development user stories within the SDLC process. Perform exploratory testing, system level end to end testing, develop test datasets and execute automation scripts (to ensure application software releases are of high quality). Evaluate test cases for automation suitability and execute conversion as required. Review System Specifications/Requirements documents, user stories and create verification test plan / cases (based on those requirements) and execute test cases. Evaluate test plan for sufficient test coverage. Ensure efficiency of test plan by identifying overlap with other testing efforts and adjust accordingly. Create verification and validation test plans, test reports, trace matrices and review with relevant stakeholders (dev and quality). Review other test plans and provide feedback to other users concerning potential gaps or overlaps. Review deliverables/activities as identified in the test plans for accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compliance. Provide input/feedback to development team when design inputs (system Specifications/Requirements, user stories, etc.) are being updated. Provide regular status reports. Use established metrics to monitor status and progress. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree or - An equivalent combination of education (HS Diploma) and equivalent of work experience 2+ years' experience plus degree or equivalent years in addition to education. Moderate knowledge of Agile methodologies Moderate level of understanding of test-driven methodologies Demonstrated success in technical proficiency, creativity, and independent thought Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong analytical & problem-solving skills Ability to multi-task and prioritize responsibilities Preferred Qualifications Moderate level of ability to conduct thorough data analytics & implement data-driven solutions. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related engineering field 3+ years of professional full-time experience in similar field. Moderate level of knowledge with continuous integration & continuous deployment (CI/CD). Moderate knowledge of Agile methodologies. Moderate level of understanding of test methodologies. Experience with Quality Center/HP ALM. Testing experience with web-based User Interfaces. Testing experience with SUSE, Apache, and Postgres systems. Experience working in a medical lab (experience in medical devices) Demonstrated success in technical proficiency, creativity, and independent thought. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical & problem-solving skills. Ability to multi-task and prioritize responsibilities. The base pay for this position is $61,300.00 – $122,700.00 In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted. jobs.title: Hardware Systems Engineer
jobs.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin About The Department Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet. About The Role We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Engineering teams, Product and Performance teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to design, qualify and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of servers What You'll Do Support and assist in the end to end server product qualification from concept to deployment, ensuring hardware designs (electrical, thermal and mechanical) are optimized for seamless, large-scale implementation by the Infrastructure Operations team. Support and assist gathering product requirements for next generation of servers, and work with silicon vendors to assess performance and select the components (CPU, memory, disk, NIC, GPUs etc) Collaborate closely with strategy, sourcing, and capacity planning teams to steer server infrastructure initiatives in alignment with Cloudflare’s business goals Collaborate with the Site Reliability Engineering team to onboard and integrate the next generation of servers into provisioning tools and fleet management tools. Collaborate with performance team and software teams to optimize software performance on the hardware Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy firmware updates, triage hardware problem reports, resolve hardware issues, maintain automation tools. Communicate your results and updates through blog posts and internal talks Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science Foundational knowledge or internship/academic experience with compute design engineering, validation, performance benchmarking, debugging, and deployment used in the data center Curiosity and desire to learn about the Cloudflare hardware and products used by 20% of all web sites Desire to learn how a diverse server fleet is managed at scale with tools such as traffic management, capacity planning and failover mechanisms Desire to learn the tools Cloudflare uses to maintain and monitor our hardware Harness AI tools and automation to fundamentally accelerate the qualification lifecycle, driving exponential efficiency gains and quality standards. Possess the organizational skills and interest to manage cross-functional technical projects, ensuring architectural designs seamlessly align with delivery schedules. Thrive as a deeply self-motivated engineer in ambiguous environments, demonstrating a strong bias for action and the ability to drive initiatives forward without close supervision. Bonus Points Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science Knowledge and experience with server hardware including motherboard designs, chassis designs, thermal designs, as well as CPU, memory & storage technology Knowledge of bash, python and basic Linux task automation Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols, and experience with firmware updates Knowledge or experience of performance optimization based on hardware / software codesign Knowledge and experience of debugging server hardware faults and the ability to engage with our sourcing team and vendors to improve quality Experience of working with external vendors on server hardware qualification. Experience of observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, as well as the ability to observe trends over time Experience with software development tools and processes such as Git, TeamCity and Jira Experience in a hyperscale cloud infrastructure role also valuable Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. jobs.title: Associate Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description You will manage the design, testing and supporting of firmware/embedded software application for existing and next generation of Rockwell Automation products following engineering best processes, and in partnership with team members across the globe. You will meet project deliverables with high quality and to work in a diverse team environment. You will be reporting to a Engineering manager based in Singapore. Your Responsibilities: Minimal 1 years relevant experience in embedded software product development. We welcome candidates with no experience to apply with us. Experience developing embedded software using C and C++ programming language. Experience programming 32 bits Microcontroller and developing low level device driver. Bachelor or Master in Computer Science / Embedded Systems/Computer. Engineering / Electrical Electronic Engineering Concentration in Embedded Software Engineering. The Essentials - You Will Have: Experience with development in the following areas for embedded system: Development with Real Time Operation System Develop communication protocols like Ethernet/USB/WiFi and CAN/Profibus, and IO-Link Automated unit test methodology We would like you to have 3+ years of related experience. We would open to consider candidate with no full-time experience but are passionate to join. The Preferred - You Might Also Have: Passion in embedded engineering. Have desired for continuous improvement in applying best practice and modern technologies in embedded design and processes. Experience developing Design document for firmware/embedded software. Have knowledge in different established design techniques and design patterns. Experience different hardware-assisted debugging tools. Have knowledge in Secure Coding CERT C/C++ standard. Have knowledge or experience in Functional Safety/ Security Development processes will be advantage. A willingness to experiment within acceptable boundaries and to bring novel solutions into design. You will co Experience communicating updates and resolutions to customers and other partner so collaborate with other teams in multicultural environment. What We Offer: Health Insurance including comprehensive In-patient coverage along with Top-up plans for voluntary coverage upgrade. Out-Patient benefits including clinical consultation, prescribed medication, telemedicine, health screening, dental & vision. Life and Accident Protection – covering death and disability due to natural cause, illness, and accident. Hybrid & Remote flexible work options along with Paid Time off International Travel and medical assistance Retirement Benefits – Contributions to Employees Provident Fund scheme, Gratuity and Voluntary participation in National Pension System (NPS) Personalized well-being program for healthy lifestyle changes, Clam mindfulness subscription, EAP program and Childcare Creche services at corporate rates. At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just you or other roles. #LI-Hybrid #LI-NC1 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.
